How many times must Sara mow the lawn before she can afford the jacket and two pairs of shoes? Sara wants to buy a new jacket and two pairs of shoes. The jacket costs $30, and each pair of shoes costs $20. Sara babysits the neighbor's kids four times and earns $5 each time. Sara's parents pay her $4 each time she mows the lawn. Sara had $10 saved before she started babysitting.
